incident-bot: ALERT fired: p99 inference latency > 2.5s across eu-west-1 for route /v1/generate (SLO p99=1.0s). PagerDuty: https://pd.example/incidents/P12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 triggered, urgency: high. Auto-page to #eng-oncall.
alex: acked P12345 — jumping in. Anyone already triaging?
mira: saw the spike on dashboards, looks like tail latency on token-generation path. p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~3.1s. Affected models: rdx-3b-quant.
samir: adding context — we rolled out quantization fallback config yesterday to reduce costs. Could be a perf regression under certain sequence lengths.
ops-shift: i'm oncall, forwarding to infra SRE. I've paged infra as well.
emma: confirmed customer reports from EU are incoming (support ticket #4289). They report lag in chat responses.
alex: quick sanity checks: rolling 1) check GPU utilization, 2) check queue depth, 3) look for KV cache misses.
# alex ran: 
```
kubectl top pods -n inference | grep rdx-3b
kubectl get hpa -n inference
```
alex: GPU utils are okay (~60%), but many pods show high RPS and long request queues. Queue length on sidecars ~120.
mira: KV cache hit rate dropped 18% in last 10m. Might be eviction pattern.
samir: timeline — deploy-bot shows a canary of quant-fallback landed 00:40 UTC (1h ago).
deploy-bot: Canary deployment rdx-3b-quant v2 -> v3 completed to 10%. See: https://ci.example/deploys/rdx-3b-quant/456
ops-shift: decision? mitigate or rollback canary to reduce p99 asap.
alex: propose quick mitigations: scale inference pool by +30% in eu-west, warm KV cache by replaying hot prefixes, and throttle non-critical routes (embeddings/batch-async). If p99 persists then rollback canary.
mira: thumbs on that plan. I'll start warming prefix cache from recent traces.
samir: i'll prepare rollback command and keep it ready: 
```
kubectl set image deployment/rdx-3b-quant rdx-3b-quant=rdx-3b-quant:v2 -n inference
```
ops-shift: scaling now — running autoscaler override: 
```
./infractl scale --pool inference-eu-west --add 8
```
ops-shift: scaling reported success, new capacity online (8 extra GPUs).
alex: started route throttles: updated feature-flag to deprioritize embeddings on eu-west routes.
